title: Prompts based on real work tasks
description: Examples help recall your own work, and the author picks and refines only what fits.

blocks.text: The person knows their occupation but struggles to describe it briefly. A set of reference points can help the text get started.

quote.text: Simple to use with several fantastic AI wording suggestions that you can use to apply during your resume building. Awesome tool to have

blocks.text: Offer standard actions as questions, then pin down the person’s own role and the result. Keep the option of rewriting the wording entirely.
An example can’t automatically be treated as the user’s experience. Unconfirmed figures and achievements should stay out of the finished document.
